# Agent Instructions — aosu

You can browse products and shop at aosu's online store, https://www.aosulife.com, on your user's behalf. This guide covers the Shop skill and UCP integration, directly or through browser-based WebMCP tools.

## Shop skill — recommended

Use the [Shop skill](https://shop.com/SKILL.md) to help your user shop with this store. Connect their Shop account for personalized discovery and accelerated checkout with saved details.

- Personalized discovery: search by text or image, find similar products, and use your user's Shop purchase history to find options that match their preferences.
- Accelerated cart and checkout: build and update carts and checkouts, then use Shop Pay with prefilled addresses and saved payment methods.
- Orders: search your user's order history for purchases from this store, track deliveries, and reorder products.

Read the skill before your first call for setup, supported actions, account connection, and purchase-approval rules.

## UCP integration

This store implements the [Universal Commerce Protocol](https://ucp.dev) for product discovery, carts, and checkout. Integrate directly with its service, or orchestrate shopping through browser-based WebMCP tools.

### Direct integration (MCP)

1. **Discover the store** — `GET https://www.aosulife.com/.well-known/ucp` returns its UCP profile, including capabilities, service endpoints, and payment handlers.
2. **Discover available tools** — Connect to the MCP endpoint advertised in the profile (`https://www.aosulife.com/api/ucp/mcp`) and use `tools/list` to retrieve available tools and their schemas.
3. **Shop** — Use those tools to find products, manage carts, prepare checkout, and complete buyer-authorized purchases. Follow returned statuses, messages, and handoff URLs when buyer action is required.

Use a compatible UCP version and follow the returned tool schemas. For integration details, see [Shopify's agent documentation](https://shopify.dev/docs/agents).

### Browser integration (WebMCP)

When working through a browser, use the WebMCP tools registered on this store's pages. The checkout page exposes UCP tools over WebMCP. These tools act on the checkout in the current browser session.

- **Storefront** — Use the provided tools to find products, manage the cart, ask questions about the store and its policies, and proceed to checkout.
- **Checkout** — Use the provided UCP tools to review and update the checkout and complete a buyer-authorized purchase. Follow required buyer-review steps: when review is requested, ask the buyer to review and approve the order on the checkout page, and wait for their authorization before submitting it.

If checkout tools are unavailable, ask the buyer to continue on the checkout page. Do not fall back to scripted form fills or page controls.

For integration details, see [Storefront WebMCP](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/web-mcp) and [Checkout WebMCP](https://shopify.dev/docs/agents/carts-and-checkout/checkout-webmcp).

## Interaction guidelines

- **Buyer authorization** — Place orders and submit payment only with the buyer's authorization. Follow required review and approval steps.
- **Agent traffic** — Agents must identify their requests as agent-initiated. Server-to-server requests and hosted or remote browsers must use [Web Bot Auth](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/storefront#identifying-bots-with-web-bot-auth) and follow the service's authentication requirements. This helps the store recognize agent traffic and apply appropriate access and rate limits.
- **Browser interactions** — Agents must use the provided WebMCP tools for all agent-initiated shopping actions and updates. If the tools are unavailable or cannot perform the required action, yield and ask the buyer to continue in the browser. Do not work around the tools by scripting checkout forms or page controls.
- **Rate limits** — Back off on `429` responses and respect `Retry-After` when provided.
- **Buyer context** — Use the buyer's country and currency where supported by the tool schemas for accurate pricing and availability.

## Read-only browsing

Prefer the structured information returned by the shopping tools described above. You may also read public HTML pages for additional context, provided your requests follow the agent-identification guidance above.

- Discover public URLs through `/sitemap.xml`.
- Read product pages at `/products/{handle}`.
- Browse collections at `/collections/all` or `/collections/{handle}`.
- Discover other public pages and articles through the sitemap.

Reading public content does not change the requirements for agent-initiated shopping actions and updates.


## Platform

This store is built on [Shopify](https://www.shopify.com), the commerce platform powering millions of stores worldwide. Shopify stores support UCP natively, enabling seamless agent-driven commerce. The Shop skill at
[https://shop.app/SKILL.md](https://shop.app/SKILL.md) works across every Shopify store — install it once and
your agent can transact everywhere.

- Start your own store: https://www.shopify.com/start
- Build and test against sample data: https://mock.shop (free mock Storefront GraphQL API, no store or auth needed)
- Shopify developer platform: https://shopify.dev
- Shop developer platform: https://shop.dev

- Agent discovery: the canonical agent-facing description of the store is at `/agents.md`. You're reading `/llms.txt`, which mirrors that content.

    <script>
  window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
  function gtag() { dataLayer.push(arguments); }

  // 1. 每个页面先默认 不同意追踪 及 不接受 cookie
  gtag('consent', 'default', {
  analytics_storage: 'denied',
  ad_storage: 'denied',
  ad_user_data: 'denied',
  ad_personalization: 'denied',
  wait_for_update: 500,
  region: [ // to apply default to specific countries only
    'CN'
  ],
  });
  //'AT', 'BE', 'BG', 'CY', 'CZ', 'DE', 'DK', 'EE', 'ES', 'FI', 'FR', 'GR', 'HR', 'HU', 'IE', 'IS', 'IT', 'LI', 'LT', 'LU', 'LV', 'MT', 'NL', 'NO', 'PL', 'PT', 'RO', 'SE', 'SI', 'SK',

  // 2. 根据用户之前是否同意的选项 在每个页面自动触发 代码同意追踪 及 cookie
  if (localStorage['gtag.consent.option'] !== undefined) {
  const option = JSON.parse(localStorage['gtag.consent.option']);
  gtag('consent', 'update', option);
  }

  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    const isAcceptAll = e.target.matches(
      '#shopify-pc__banner__btn-accept, #shopify-pc__prefs__header-accept'
    );

    const isRejectAll = e.target.matches(
      '#shopify-pc__banner__btn-decline, #shopify-pc__prefs__header-decline'
    );

    const isSaveCustom = e.target.matches(
      '#shopify-pc__prefs__dialog #shopify-pc__prefs__header-save'
    );

    if (
      isAcceptAll === false &&
      isRejectAll === false &&
      isSaveCustom === false
    ) {
      return;
    }

    let option;

    if (isAcceptAll) {
      option = {
        analytics_storage: 'granted',
        ad_storage: 'granted',
        ad_user_data: 'granted',
        ad_personalization: 'granted'
      };
    }

    if (isRejectAll) {
      option = {
        analytics_storage: 'denied',
        ad_storage: 'denied',
        ad_user_data: 'denied',
        ad_personalization: 'denied'
      };
    }

    if (isSaveCustom) {
      option = {
        analytics_storage: 'denied',
        ad_storage: 'denied',
        ad_user_data: 'denied',
        ad_personalization: 'denied'
      };

      const form = e.target.closest('#shopify-pc__prefs__dialog');

      if (
        form.querySelector('#shopify-pc__prefs__analytics-input').checked === true
      ) {
        option.analytics_storage = 'granted';
      }

      if (
        form.querySelector('#shopify-pc__prefs__marketing-input').checked === true
      ) {
        option.ad_storage = 'granted';
        option.ad_user_data = 'granted';
        option.ad_personalization = 'granted';
      }
    }

    gtag('consent', 'update', option);

    if (isRejectAll) {
      localStorage.removeItem('gtag.consent.option');
    } else {
      localStorage['gtag.consent.option'] = JSON.stringify(option);
    }
  });

<script>
  const blockScripts = [
    'preview-bar',
    'rivyo-script',
    'klaviyo.js',
    'fwcdn3.com'
  ];

  const blockExec = [
    'ecomsend.js',
    'worry-free-purchase'
  ];

  
  

  const shouldBlock = (node) => {
    if (node.src) {
      return blockScripts.some(k => node.src.includes(k));
    }
    return blockExec.some(k => node.textContent.includes(k));
  };

  const makeLazy = (node) => {
    node.dataset.type = node.type || 'text/javascript';
    node.type = 'text/lazyload';

    if (node.src) {
      node.dataset.src = node.src;
      node.removeAttribute('src');
    }
  };

  const scopeObserver = new MutationObserver(mutations => {
    for (const { addedNodes } of mutations) {
      for (const node of addedNodes) {
        if (node.nodeType !== 1 || node.tagName !== 'SCRIPT') continue;
        if (!shouldBlock(node)) continue;
        makeLazy(node);
      }
    }
  });

  scopeObserver.observe(document.documentElement, {
    childList: true,
    subtree: true
  });
</script>

        function uuid() {
            var s = [];
            var hexDigits = "0123456789abcdef";
            for (var i = 0; i < 36; i++) {
                s[i] = hexDigits.substr(Math.floor(Math.random() * 0x10), 1);
            }
            s[14] = "4";
            s[19] = hexDigits.substr((s[19] & 0x3) | 0x8, 1);

  <script>
    (function() {
      const SESSION_KEY = 'aosu:change-country-bar-dismissed';
      const HEIGHT_VAR = '--country-bar-height';
      
      const currentCountry = "US";
      const nonAppRedirectEnabled = true;
      const appRedirectEnabled = false;
      const rawRules = [
      {
        "countries": ["DE", "AT"],
        "url": "https://de.aosulife.com/",
        "app_url": "https://de.aosulife.com/collections/sale",
        "title": "Shopping from Germany?",
        "subtitle": "Wir haben einen speziellen Shop für Deutschland und Österreich gefunden.",
        "stay_text": "Stay on Current Store",
        "confirm_text": "Wechseln"
      }
    ];
      const globalDefaultConfirmText = "Wechseln";

      console.log('[CountryBar] Country:', currentCountry);

      let redirectUrl = '';
      let appRedirectUrl = '';
      let ruleTitle = '';
      let ruleSubtitle = '';
      let ruleStayText = 'Stay on Current Store';
      let ruleConfirmText = globalDefaultConfirmText;
      let shouldAutoShow = false;

      try {
        const rules = typeof rawRules === 'string' ? JSON.parse(rawRules) : rawRules;
        if (Array.isArray(rules)) {
          const matchedRule = rules.find(rule => 
            Array.isArray(rule.countries) && 
            rule.countries.map(c => c.toUpperCase()).includes(currentCountry.toUpperCase())
          );

          if (matchedRule) {
            shouldAutoShow = true;
            redirectUrl = matchedRule.url || '';
            appRedirectUrl = matchedRule.app_url || '';
            ruleTitle = matchedRule.title || matchedRule.message || '';
            ruleSubtitle = matchedRule.subtitle || '';

            if (matchedRule.stay_text && matchedRule.stay_text.trim() !== '') {
              ruleStayText = matchedRule.stay_text;
            }
            if (matchedRule.confirm_text && matchedRule.confirm_text.trim() !== '') {
              ruleConfirmText = matchedRule.confirm_text;
            }
          } else {
            console.warn('[CountryBar] country:', currentCountry);
          }
        }
      } catch (e) {
        
      }

      const bar = document.getElementById('change-country-bar');

      function isCurrentHostRedirectTarget(url) {
        if (!url || url.trim() === '') return false;
        try {
          const targetUrl = new URL(url, window.location.href);
          return targetUrl.hostname === window.location.hostname;
        } catch (error) {
          return false;
        }
      }

      function isOpenedInApp() {
        try {
          const userAgent = navigator.userAgent || '';
          return userAgent.toLowerCase().includes('glazerowebview');
        } catch (error) {
          return false;
        }
      }

      function applyBarHeight() {
        if (!bar) return;
        document.documentElement.style.setProperty(HEIGHT_VAR, bar.offsetHeight + 'px');
      }

      function clearBarHeight() {
        document.documentElement.style.removeProperty(HEIGHT_VAR);
      }

      function show() {
        if (!bar) return;
        bar.style.display = 'block';
        bar.dataset.state = 'open';
        applyBarHeight();
      }

      function hide() {
        if (!bar) return;
        bar.style.display = 'none';
        bar.dataset.state = 'closed';
        clearBarHeight();
        try {
          window.sessionStorage.setItem(SESSION_KEY, 'true');
        } catch (error) {}
      }

      function confirmRedirect() {
        if (redirectUrl && redirectUrl.trim() !== '' && !isCurrentHostRedirectTarget(redirectUrl)) {
          window.location.replace(redirectUrl);
        }
      }

      function redirectInApp() {
        if (!appRedirectEnabled || !appRedirectUrl || appRedirectUrl.trim() === '') return;
        if (!isCurrentHostRedirectTarget(appRedirectUrl)) {
          window.location.replace(appRedirectUrl);
        }
      }

      window.showChangeCountryBar = show;
      window.hideChangeCountryBar = hide;
      window.changeCountryBarConfirm = confirmRedirect;

      document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        if (!shouldAutoShow) return;

        const titleEl = bar ? bar.querySelector('[data-change-country-title]') : null;
        if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = ruleTitle;

        const subtitleEl = bar ? bar.querySelector('[data-change-country-subtitle]') : null;
        if (subtitleEl) subtitleEl.textContent = ruleSubtitle;

        const stayTextEl = bar ? bar.querySelector('[data-change-country-stay-text]') : null;
        if (stayTextEl && ruleStayText) stayTextEl.textContent = ruleStayText;

        const confirmTextEl = bar ? bar.querySelector('[data-change-country-confirm-text]') : null;
        if (confirmTextEl && ruleConfirmText) confirmTextEl.textContent = ruleConfirmText;

        if (isOpenedInApp()) {
          redirectInApp();
          return;
        }

        if (!nonAppRedirectEnabled || !bar) {
          return;
        }

        const confirmButton = bar.querySelector('[data-change-country-confirm]');
        const closeButtons = bar.querySelectorAll('[data-change-country-close]');

        if (confirmButton) {
          confirmButton.addEventListener('click', confirmRedirect);
        }

        closeButtons.forEach(btn => {
          btn.addEventListener('click', hide);
        });

        let dismissed = false;
        try {
          dismissed = window.sessionStorage.getItem(SESSION_KEY) === 'true';
        } catch (error) {}

        if (dismissed) {
          return;
        }

        if (isCurrentHostRedirectTarget(redirectUrl)) {
          return;
        }

        show();
      });

      window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
        if (bar && bar.dataset.state === 'open') {
          applyBarHeight();
        }
      });
    })();
  </script><div id="customHeaderConainer">

<script>
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
          const menuTags = document.querySelectorAll('.leftMenuTag');
          const menuContentContainers = document.querySelectorAll('.menuContentContainer');
          const resetMenuState = () => {
            menuContentContainers.forEach((content) => (content.style.display = 'none'));
            menuTags.forEach((tag) => {
              tag.classList.remove('leftMenuTagActive');
            });
          };
          const handleMenuHover = (index) => {
            const currentTag = menuTags[index];
            if ((currentTag.dataset.level && currentTag.dataset.level > 0) || currentTag.dataset.url.includes('#')) {
              resetMenuState();
              currentTag.classList.add('leftMenuTagActive');
              //menuContentContainers[index].style.display = 'block';
              // 重置滚动位置到顶部
              //menuContentContainers[index].scrollTop = 0;
              const currentContainer = menuContentContainers[index];
              currentContainer.style.display = 'block';
              // 重置滚动位置到顶部
              currentContainer.scrollTop = 0;
              const firstTab = currentContainer.querySelector('.menuContentContainer__collection-tab__item');
              if (firstTab) {
                // 手动派发 mouseenter 事件，触发原有的 Tab 切换逻辑
                firstTab.dispatchEvent(new Event('mouseenter'));
              }
            }
          };

          menuTags.forEach((tag, index) => {
            tag.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => handleMenuHover(index));
          });


          // menuContentContainer__collection-tab__item hover切换menuContentContainer__collection-link
          const collectionTabItems = document.querySelectorAll('.menuContentContainer__collection-tab__item');
          const menuContentContainerCollectionLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.menuContentContainer__collection-link');
          const menuContentBoxWrappers = document.querySelectorAll('.menuContentBoxWrapper');
          const menuContentBoxSpecials = document.querySelectorAll('.menuContentBox_special');
          collectionTabItems.forEach((item) => {
            item.addEventListener('mouseenter', (e) => {
              // 如果 hover 的是当前的元素，则不进行任何操作
              if (e.target.classList.contains('active')) {
                return;
              }
              const index = Array.from(collectionTabItems).indexOf(e.target);
              const id = e.target.dataset.id;

              collectionTabItems.forEach((item) => {
                item.classList.remove('active');
              });

              menuContentContainerCollectionLinks.forEach((link) => {
                link.style.display = 'none';
              });

              menuContentBoxWrappers.forEach((wrapper) => {
                const wrapperId = wrapper.dataset.id;
                if (wrapperId == id) {
                  wrapper.classList.add('active');
                } else {
                  wrapper.classList.remove('active');
                }
                /*const wrapperIndex = wrapper.dataset.index;
                if (wrapperIndex == index) {
                  wrapper.classList.add('active');
                } else {
                  wrapper.classList.remove('active');
                }*/
              });
              menuContentBoxSpecials.forEach((special) => {
                special.classList.remove('active');
              });
         
              e.target.classList.add('active');
              menuContentBoxSpecials[index].classList.add('active');
              menuContentContainerCollectionLinks[index].style.display = 'flex';
            });
          });
        });

<script>
(function() {
  const carousel = document.querySelector('slideshow-carousel');
  const slideshow = document.querySelector('x-slideshow');
  
  let isCurrentVideoPlaying = false;
  let videoTimeout = null;
  function initVideoControl(video, player) {
    if (!video) {
      releaseToDefaultCarousel(player);
      return;
    }

    if (isCurrentVideoPlaying) return;

    if (player && typeof player.pause === 'function') {
      player.pause();
    }

    video.classList.remove('video-already-played');
    isCurrentVideoPlaying = true;

    video.muted = true;
    video.setAttribute('muted', '');
    video.setAttribute('playsinline', '');
    video.setAttribute('webkit-playsinline', 'true');

    if (videoTimeout) clearTimeout(videoTimeout);

    videoTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
      if (!video.playing && isCurrentVideoPlaying) {
        isCurrentVideoPlaying = false;
        triggerNext(player);
      }
    }, 4000);

    video.currentTime = 0;
    const playPromise = video.play();
    
    if (playPromise !== undefined) {
      playPromise.then(() => {
      }).catch((err) => {
        isCurrentVideoPlaying = false;
        triggerNext(player);
      });
    }

    video.onplaying = () => {
      if (videoTimeout) clearTimeout(videoTimeout); 
      if (player && typeof player.pause === 'function') player.pause(); 
    };

    video.onended = () => {
      video.classList.add('video-already-played');
      video.pause();
      video.currentTime = 0;
      isCurrentVideoPlaying = false;

      videoTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
        triggerNext(player);
      }, 2500);
    };
  }

  function releaseToDefaultCarousel(player) {
    isCurrentVideoPlaying = false;
    if (videoTimeout) clearTimeout(videoTimeout);
    
    if (player && typeof player.play === 'function') {
      player.play();
    }
  }

  function triggerNext(player) {
    if (player && typeof player.play === 'function') player.play();
    
    const target = carousel || slideshow;
    if (!target) return;
    
    if (typeof target.next === 'function') {
      target.next();
    } else if (target.model && typeof target.model.next === 'function') {
      target.model.next();
    }
  }

  function getActiveVideo(slide) {
    if (!slide) return null;
    const isMobile = window.innerWidth <= 749;
    return isMobile ? slide.querySelector('.mobile-video') : slide.querySelector('.desktop-video');
  }

  if (carousel) {
    const slideObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          const activeSlide = carousel.querySelector('.is-selected, .active, [selected]');
          const video = getActiveVideo(activeSlide);
          const player = carousel._player;

          initVideoControl(video, player);
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.05 });

    slideObserver.observe(carousel);

    const mutationObserver = new MutationObserver((mutations) => {
      mutations.forEach((mutation) => {
        if (mutation.type === 'attributes') {
          const slide = mutation.target;
          const isActive = slide.classList.contains('is-selected') || 
                           slide.classList.contains('active') || 
                           slide.hasAttribute('selected');
          
          const player = carousel._player;
          
          if (isActive) {
            isCurrentVideoPlaying = false; 
            const video = getActiveVideo(slide);
            initVideoControl(video, player);
          } else {
            const hiddenVideo = getActiveVideo(slide);
            if (hiddenVideo) {
              hiddenVideo.classList.remove('video-already-played'); 
              hiddenVideo.pause();
              hiddenVideo.currentTime = 0; 
            }
          }
        }
      });
    });

    const slides = carousel.querySelectorAll('.slideshow__slide, [role="group"]');
    slides.forEach(slide => {
      mutationObserver.observe(slide, { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class', 'selected'] });
    });
  }
})();

          function setupSecurityVideoPlayback() {
              var root = document.currentScript ? document.currentScript.parentElement : null;
              if (!root || !root.classList.contains("newSecurityTotalBox")) {
                  root = document.querySelector(".newSecurityTotalBox");
              }
              if (!root || root.dataset.videoPlaybackReady === "true") return;

              var videos = root.querySelectorAll("video");

              var sectionInView = false;

              function isVisibleVideo(video) {

                  var node = target;

                  while (node && node !== root) {

                          return false;
                      }
                      node = node.parentElement;
                  }

                  var rect = target.getBoundingClientRect();
                  return rect.width > 0 && rect.height > 0;
              }

              function isVideoInViewport(video, minVisibleRatio) {
                  if (!isVisibleVideo(video)) return false;

                  var wrap = video.closest(".securityBoxRightVideoWrap");
                  var rect = (wrap || video).getBoundingClientRect();
                  var viewWidth = window.innerWidth || document.documentElement.clientWidth;
                  var viewHeight = window.innerHeight || document.documentElement.clientHeight;
                  var visibleWidth = Math.min(rect.right, viewWidth) - Math.max(rect.left, 0);
                  var visibleHeight = Math.min(rect.bottom, viewHeight) - Math.max(rect.top, 0);

                  if (visibleWidth <= 0 || visibleHeight <= 0) return false;

                  var visibleArea = visibleWidth * visibleHeight;
                  var totalArea = rect.width * rect.height;
                  if (totalArea <= 0) return false;

                  return visibleArea / totalArea >= (minVisibleRatio || 0.35);
              }

              function getMobileVideosToPlay() {
                  var mobileBox = root.querySelector(".securityBox");
                  if (!mobileBox || !isLayoutVisible(root.querySelector(".securityTotalBox"))) {
                      return [];
                  }

                  var mobileVideos = mobileBox.querySelectorAll(".securityBoxRight video");
                  var targets = [];

                  for (var i = 0; i < mobileVideos.length; i++) {
                      if (isVideoInViewport(mobileVideos[i], 0.1)) {
                          targets.push(mobileVideos[i]);
                      }
                  }

                  return targets;
              }

              function onMobileScroll() {
                  if (!isMobileLayout() || !sectionInView) return;
                  if (mobileScrollRaf) return;

                  mobileScrollRaf = requestAnimationFrame(function() {
                      mobileScrollRaf = 0;
                      playVisibleVideos();
                  });
              }

              function bindMobileScrollListener() {
                  if (mobileScrollBound || !isMobileLayout()) return;
                  window.addEventListener("scroll", onMobileScroll, { passive: true });
                  mobileScrollBound = true;
              }

              function unbindMobileScrollListener() {
                  if (!mobileScrollBound) return;
                  window.removeEventListener("scroll", onMobileScroll);
                  mobileScrollBound = false;
                  if (mobileScrollRaf) {
                      cancelAnimationFrame(mobileScrollRaf);
                      mobileScrollRaf = 0;
                  }
              }

              function isLayoutVisible(element) {
                  return element && window.getComputedStyle(element).display !== "none";
              }

              function getActiveStickyVideo() {
                  var slides = root.querySelectorAll(".securityVideoView .securityVideo");
                  var activeSlide = null;
                  var maxZ = -1;

                  for (var i = 0; i < slides.length; i++) {
                      var z = parseInt(window.getComputedStyle(slides[i]).zIndex, 10) || 0;
                      if (z >= maxZ) {
                          maxZ = z;
                          activeSlide = slides[i];
                      }
                  }

                  return activeSlide ? activeSlide.querySelector("video") : null;
              }

              function getVideosToPlay() {
                  if (isMobileLayout()) {
                      return getMobileVideosToPlay();
                  }

                  var totalBox = root.querySelector(".securityTotalBox");
                  var totalBox75 = root.querySelector(".securityTotalBox75");

                  if (isLayoutVisible(totalBox)) {
                      var activeVideo = getActiveStickyVideo();
                      return activeVideo ? [activeVideo] : [];
                  }

                  if (isLayoutVisible(totalBox75)) {
                      var layout75Videos = totalBox75.querySelectorAll("video");
                      var visible75Targets = [];
                      for (var j = 0; j < layout75Videos.length; j++) {
                          if (isVisibleVideo(layout75Videos[j])) {
                              visible75Targets.push(layout75Videos[j]);
                          }
                      }
                      return visible75Targets;
                  }

                  return [];
              }

              function shouldPlayVideo(video, targets) {
                  for (var t = 0; t < targets.length; t++) {
                      if (targets[t] === video) return true;
                  }
                  return false;
              }

              function playVisibleVideos() {
                  var targets = getVideosToPlay();

                  for (var i = 0; i < videos.length; i++) {
                      if (shouldPlayVideo(videos[i], targets)) {
                          prepareVideoForPlayback(videos[i]);
                          var playPromise = videos[i].play();
                          if (playPromise && playPromise.catch) {
                              playPromise.catch(function() {});
                          }
                      } else if (!videos[i].paused) {
                          videos[i].pause();
                      }
                  }
              }

              function pauseVideos() {
                  for (var i = 0; i < videos.length; i++) {
                      videos[i].pause();
                  }
              }

              function syncVideoPlayback() {
                  if (sectionInView && !document.hidden) {
                      playVisibleVideos();
                  } else {
                      pauseVideos();
                  }
              }

              root.aosuSyncVideoPlayback = syncVideoPlayback;

              if ("IntersectionObserver" in window) {
                  var observer = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries) {
                      sectionInView = entries.some(function(entry) {
                          return entry.isIntersecting;

                      syncVideoPlayback();

                  observer.observe(root);

                  var rootRect = root.getBoundingClientRect();
                  var viewHeight = window.innerHeight || document.documentElement.clientHeight;
                  if (rootRect.bottom > 0 && rootRect.top < viewHeight) {

                      syncVideoPlayback();

              } else {
                  window.addEventListener("load", function() {
                      sectionInView = true;
                      syncVideoPlayback();
                  }, { once: true });
              }

              document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", syncVideoPlayback);
              window.addEventListener("resize", function() {
                  if (isMobileLayout()) {
                      bindMobileScrollListener();

              }

              window.addEventListener("load", syncVideoPlayback, { once: true });
              requestAnimationFrame(syncVideoPlayback);
          }

            (function () {
              var root = document.getElementById("videoTotal");
              if (!root || root.dataset.cloudStoryPlaybackReady === "true") return;

              var videos = root.querySelectorAll("video.videoTopImg[data-src]");
              if (!videos.length) return;

              root.dataset.cloudStoryPlaybackReady = "true";

              function prepareCloudStoryVideo(video) {
                var source = video.getAttribute("data-src");
                if (!source || video.src) return;

                video.src = source.trim();
                video.removeAttribute("data-src");
                video.preload = "metadata";
              }

              function prepareCloudStoryVideosInView() {
                var viewHeight = window.innerHeight || document.documentElement.clientHeight;

                for (var i = 0; i < videos.length; i++) {
                  var video = videos[i];
                  if (!video.getAttribute("data-src")) continue;

                  var rect = video.getBoundingClientRect();
                  if (rect.bottom > 0 && rect.top < viewHeight) {
                    prepareCloudStoryVideo(video);
                  }
                }
              }

              root.addEventListener(
                "click",
                function (event) {
                  var video = event.target.closest("video.videoTopImg");
                  if (video) prepareCloudStoryVideo(video);
                },
                true
              );

              if ("IntersectionObserver" in window) {
                var sectionInView = false;

                var observer = new IntersectionObserver(
                  function (entries) {
                    sectionInView = entries.some(function (entry) {
                      return entry.isIntersecting;
                    });
                    if (sectionInView) prepareCloudStoryVideosInView();
                  },
                  { rootMargin: "200px 0px", threshold: 0.05 }
                );

                observer.observe(root);

                var rect = root.getBoundingClientRect();
                var viewHeight = window.innerHeight || document.documentElement.clientHeight;
                if (rect.bottom > 0 && rect.top < viewHeight) {
                  sectionInView = true;
                  prepareCloudStoryVideosInView();
                }
              }
            })();

# Agent Instructions — aosu

You can browse products and shop at aosu's online store, https://www.aosulife.com, on your user's behalf. This guide covers the Shop skill and UCP integration, directly or through browser-based WebMCP tools.

## Shop skill — recommended

Use the [Shop skill](https://shop.com/SKILL.md) to help your user shop with this store. Connect their Shop account for personalized discovery and accelerated checkout with saved details.

- Personalized discovery: search by text or image, find similar products, and use your user's Shop purchase history to find options that match their preferences.
- Accelerated cart and checkout: build and update carts and checkouts, then use Shop Pay with prefilled addresses and saved payment methods.
- Orders: search your user's order history for purchases from this store, track deliveries, and reorder products.

Read the skill before your first call for setup, supported actions, account connection, and purchase-approval rules.

## UCP integration

This store implements the [Universal Commerce Protocol](https://ucp.dev) for product discovery, carts, and checkout. Integrate directly with its service, or orchestrate shopping through browser-based WebMCP tools.

### Direct integration (MCP)

1. **Discover the store** — `GET https://www.aosulife.com/.well-known/ucp` returns its UCP profile, including capabilities, service endpoints, and payment handlers.
2. **Discover available tools** — Connect to the MCP endpoint advertised in the profile (`https://www.aosulife.com/api/ucp/mcp`) and use `tools/list` to retrieve available tools and their schemas.
3. **Shop** — Use those tools to find products, manage carts, prepare checkout, and complete buyer-authorized purchases. Follow returned statuses, messages, and handoff URLs when buyer action is required.

Use a compatible UCP version and follow the returned tool schemas. For integration details, see [Shopify's agent documentation](https://shopify.dev/docs/agents).

### Browser integration (WebMCP)

When working through a browser, use the WebMCP tools registered on this store's pages. The checkout page exposes UCP tools over WebMCP. These tools act on the checkout in the current browser session.

- **Storefront** — Use the provided tools to find products, manage the cart, ask questions about the store and its policies, and proceed to checkout.
- **Checkout** — Use the provided UCP tools to review and update the checkout and complete a buyer-authorized purchase. Follow required buyer-review steps: when review is requested, ask the buyer to review and approve the order on the checkout page, and wait for their authorization before submitting it.

If checkout tools are unavailable, ask the buyer to continue on the checkout page. Do not fall back to scripted form fills or page controls.

For integration details, see [Storefront WebMCP](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/web-mcp) and [Checkout WebMCP](https://shopify.dev/docs/agents/carts-and-checkout/checkout-webmcp).

## Interaction guidelines

- **Buyer authorization** — Place orders and submit payment only with the buyer's authorization. Follow required review and approval steps.
- **Agent traffic** — Agents must identify their requests as agent-initiated. Server-to-server requests and hosted or remote browsers must use [Web Bot Auth](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/storefront#identifying-bots-with-web-bot-auth) and follow the service's authentication requirements. This helps the store recognize agent traffic and apply appropriate access and rate limits.
- **Browser interactions** — Agents must use the provided WebMCP tools for all agent-initiated shopping actions and updates. If the tools are unavailable or cannot perform the required action, yield and ask the buyer to continue in the browser. Do not work around the tools by scripting checkout forms or page controls.
- **Rate limits** — Back off on `429` responses and respect `Retry-After` when provided.
- **Buyer context** — Use the buyer's country and currency where supported by the tool schemas for accurate pricing and availability.

## Read-only browsing

Prefer the structured information returned by the shopping tools described above. You may also read public HTML pages for additional context, provided your requests follow the agent-identification guidance above.

- Discover public URLs through `/sitemap.xml`.
- Read product pages at `/products/{handle}`.
- Browse collections at `/collections/all` or `/collections/{handle}`.
- Discover other public pages and articles through the sitemap.

Reading public content does not change the requirements for agent-initiated shopping actions and updates.


## Platform

This store is built on [Shopify](https://www.shopify.com), the commerce platform powering millions of stores worldwide. Shopify stores support UCP natively, enabling seamless agent-driven commerce. The Shop skill at
[https://shop.app/SKILL.md](https://shop.app/SKILL.md) works across every Shopify store — install it once and
your agent can transact everywhere.

- Start your own store: https://www.shopify.com/start
- Build and test against sample data: https://mock.shop (free mock Storefront GraphQL API, no store or auth needed)
- Shopify developer platform: https://shopify.dev
- Shop developer platform: https://shop.dev
